description: Implements the iOS bridge layer for a React-Native MoEngage SDK feature. This is Step 2b of the React-Native feature pipeline (parallel to or after react-native-android-bridge-implementation). Produces the Bridge .h/.mm, Handler .h/.m, Constants .h/.m, optional Util .h/.m, and podspec for a new sdk/<featureName> module in the React-Native repo, following the Cards module standard. On completion, asks the user whether to also run react-native-ts-implementation. Do NOT use for Android-only features or JS-only changes.
